title: Indawo Yokuziphindezela Yodwa
intro: Kwiingxelo zenceba kaThixo, kukho umphefumlo omsulwa ongenakuthelekiswa nanto, owahlulwe kubantu bawo ukuze afune ukuba yedwa kwicala elingcwele. Babengazi ukuba oku kuzihlukanisa kuya kuzisa umqondiso kuzo zonke ihlabathi, uvavanyo lokholo oluya kuthethwa ngalo ngonaphakade.
clues: Ndazinikela kubomi bam bokukhonza ngaphambi kokuba ndizalwe.
Ndaxhaswa zizinto ezivela ku-Allah ezamangalisa umgcini wam.
Ndazikhupha kusapho lwam ndaya kwindawo esempuma.
Ingelosi yabonakala kum ikwimo yomntu ogqibeleleyo, izisa iindaba zonyana omsulwa.
Ndathi ndakubuya nosana lwam olusandul’ ukuzalwa, abantu bakuthi bandityhola, kodwa usana lwathetha ukundikhusela.
arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مَرْيَمَ إِذِ ٱنتَبَذَتْ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا مَكَانًۭا شَرْقِيًّۭا
verse: And mention, [O Muḥammad], in the Book [the story of] Mary, when she withdrew from her family to a place toward the east. (19:16)
